data.name: Primateria: Reburn
data.detailed_description:
Digital trading card games nail the strategy but miss the soul. They give you a ladder to climb and a button to click, and forget everything around the table: the local shop, the people, the hunt for one more card, the deck you keep tuning at 2 a.m.

Primateria: Reburn is the trading card game, brought to life. It's an adventure TCG set in a colorful fantasy world, built around the card-game experience you love. Explore a world, build a collection, and play through a story that runs from your first pack at a local shop to world champion. Collecting, deckbuilding, trading, and battling your way up the ranks is the whole game.

It starts at the card shop

Reburn is built around the real card-shop experience, dropped into a colorful fantasy world. It begins at your local shop, where the regulars know your name. Browse the shelves, crack open packs, hunt for the cards you want, and build a deck that fits your style.

A card shop is a place to play, but it's also a community, and we worked hard to make ours feel alive:

  • Argue about the meta with the locals, gossip about who's testing what, and watch the other duels while you wait for your next round.

  • Someone pulls a chase card right in front of you. Do you make an offer on the spot? Do they ask to see your binder?

  • The people here remember you. The player you beat last week might want a rematch; a friendly rival might lend you a key card for a big tournament.

  • Play every format you'd expect: Ranked, Draft, Highlander, Tag Duels, and budget events. NPC decks are built to mirror real competitive archetypes, so nobody's a pushover.

From your first pack to champion

Explore the world, open packs to grow your collection, and prove your deck at local tournaments. Win your way up the circuit and chase the title of champion. It's the collect-and-battle fantasy, fully realized.

But there's more on the line than a trophy. The deeper you travel, the more you pull at a thread some powerful people would rather keep buried, and what you find could change the world.

  • Travel region to region, each with its own shops, rivals, rotating formats, and dominant decks to crack.

  • Track down rare and powerful cards out in the world, in shops, and from players who won't part with them easily.

  • Take on the champion who reigns over each region, and beat them to earn your place at the next stage.

  • Uncover a syndicate hoarding the rarest cards and the power they hold, and the plan that puts everyone at risk.

  • Stop them, win the final showdown, and take the title of champion for yourself.

Play online, make it yours

Take your decks online and climb the ranked ladder against real players, with seasons, ELO, and leaderboards. Then make your mark: customize your character, collect cosmetics, and explore a living online world built around the card game.

  • A ranked ladder with seasons, ELO, and leaderboards.

  • Character customization and cosmetics to make it your own.

  • A living online world where the community and the meta never stop moving.

Built for the player

We built Reburn with the features we always wanted as players. No fluff, just tools that support the experience.

  • An in-game phone that keeps you connected: tournament rankings, achievements, events at nearby shops, and your friends list.

  • A proper digital binder you can flip through, sort, and filter without leaving the table.

  • Trade groups where you post your wants and haves and set up meetups for the cards you need.

  • Achievements that mean something: beat a tough opponent to unlock a high-stakes tournament, or earn a powerful card that opens up a new archetype.

In Primateria: Reburn, the climb is the point: one shop, one deck, one tournament at a time.

Reburn is in open playtest right now, and it's completely free. Jump in and start collecting today, or wishlist to follow it to launch.

Wishlist now, and join our Discord and Bluesky for devlogs and sneak peeks.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-3450
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct X11 or Vulkan compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-3750
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct X11 or Vulkan compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
